player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I entered the Home office twice without exploring the other available directions (north and east) in between, leading to a loop where I prematurely chose DONE. Next time, I will strictly follow a systematic traversal strategy: upon entering a new room, I will immediately attempt to go in every available direction (e.g., north, then east, then south, then west) before returning to the previous room or moving forward. I will only issue the "DONE" command after I have confirmed that every direction from every visited room has been taken and no new rooms remain to be discovered.
